newsitem.title: UK: Fall in import prices good news - UK Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Fall in import prices good news - UK Treasury.

text.p: The UK Treasury said in a statement the further falls in import prices was good news for inflation.

November's provisional estimates show export prices fell by one percent and import prices fell by three percent compared with October. In the three months ended November export prices fell by 0.5 percent and import prices dropped one percent.

The ONS said provisional estimates show both export and import prices virtually unchanged compared with November. Between December 1995 and December 1996 export prices have risen by 0.5 percent while import prices have fallen by 3.5 percent.
